scientific_integrity: The model and first-moment identities are credited to the initiating 2026 source; broad renewal covariance theory is credited to Patch, Nazarathy and Taimre (2014). The claimed extension is the explicit strict all-horizon sign of the many-worker variance correction and its exact formula.
scientific_limitations: Binary outcomes, conditional exponential durations, iid immediate restart, many-worker CLT with fixed t>0. Variance compared around the biased observed mean q(t), not the latent Bernoulli parameter b. General renewal durations, finite-M exact variance, and confidence coverage are not claimed; historical priority may require further specialist inspection.
title: Strict finite-budget underdispersion of pooled absorbing-outcome counts
